I will use chemical fertilizer on this maize plot because I received FISP coupons for NPK and urea, and maize needs it to produce well. I will plant hybrid seed from the subsidy program too. We do not spray chemicals or irrigate here in Dedza; we wait for the rains and weed by hand. My wife and children will work this plot, and it is small enough that we do not need to hire ganyu labor.
